title: Billing roll-up CPU incident with dict-grouping repair

task.summary: Triage a nightly billing roll-up CPU incident and remove the quadratic group-by scan.
task.instructions: Use the incident clues to localize the super-linear hotspot, apply a performance repair, and restore all roll-up tests including the behavioral grouping guards.
task.acceptance_notes: Both the ops and code requirements must pass; the aggregator must roll a batch up into one group per key with work that grows linearly with the batch size.

visible_context.issue_text: On-call opened an incident after the nightly billing roll-up job saturated CPU and overran its window whenever the platform's tenant count grew. Processing time grows super-linearly: doubling the batch size (and the number of distinct tenants in it) roughly quadruples the roll-up work.
error_logs: alerts/billing_rollup_cpu.log: roll-up CPU time per batch grows faster than batch size; doubling the batch ~4x the work
profile: a single roll-up step dominates the flame graph, its cost rising with the square of the batch size as more distinct keys accumulate
reproduction_steps: Inspect the billing roll-up fixture and run the unit tests.
Use the profile clues to localize the super-linear hotspot before applying a code fix.
visible_context.notes: The incident points at how the job locates which existing group each record belongs to, not at the number of records itself.

ops_fault.description: Synthetic nightly-billing roll-up CPU incident tied to the group_by_dict fixture.
detection_keywords: processing time grows super-linearly with batch size
doubling the batch quadruples the work
localization_keywords: quadratic hotspot in the request path
repeated linear search to find the matching group inside a loop
cost grows with the square of the input as distinct keys accumulate
scan over a growing list of already-created groups
repair_keywords: index the groups by key in a dict or defaultdict
replace the linear group search with a hash lookup
make finding a record's group O(1)
group by key with a dictionary instead of scanning a list
eliminate the per-record linear scan over the growing group list

code_fault.description: The roll-up finds each record's group by linearly scanning the list of groups built so far, making the group-by O(n^2) (O(n*g)) instead of O(n).

constraints.notes: This task expects incident localization followed by a performance fix that replaces a quadratic per-record group search with a dict-based group lookup.

notes: Combined nightly-billing roll-up CPU incident and dict-grouping repair task.
